notes.title: Wima Magicamia Released!!&Game action details
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611324/31acb88f44e9b65d1ca4d4fd37e4bc1b65de51e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I would like to make fancy world like "Wima".[/p][p]Because this action is authentic action game, little difficult.[/p][p]On this action, I am making for Intermediate game player.[/p][p]You must attack by drawing rune even if enemy is moving.[/p][p]If enemy shooting attack, you must do rolling action.[/p][p]Toward close range attack, you must do barrier action.[/p][p]Toward throw attack, you must move from the present position.[/p][p]And as story boss of "Lanyel" will use time stopping magic,[/p][p]if you did not evade action beforehand, enemy's attack hit surely.[/p][p]The extra boss who stronger than last boss is only two when released.[/p][p]although I would like to add extra boss more stronger than the present,[/p][p]I do not have idea of new boss.[/p][p]So, on boss idea, please tell us which you want to fight.[/p][p]Probably as the purchasers of this game is not such much,[/p][p]I think your opinion is reflected by high possibility.[/p]
